✨ plain-app | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: Securely managing and accessing an Android phone's data and features through a web browser without relying on cloud services.
✨ Key Features: • Web-based phone management (files, media, contacts, SMS, apps, notifications, screen mirroring) • 100% local and end-to-end encrypted • No accounts, cloud, or subscriptions required
📖 Summary: PlainApp is an open-source Android application that provides a secure, self-hosted web interface for managing your phone's files, media, contacts, SMS, and more from any device on the same network. It prioritizes privacy with end-to-end encryption and no cloud dependency, while also offering built-in Android tools like a note-taker and RSS reader.
